title: Silver Plus Saver Account: Relationship bonuses explained
summary: Explains the Silver Plus Saver Account relationship bonus: if you qualify by holding multiple eligible Rho-Bank products, your APY gets an additive +0.025% on top of your current balance tier APY. Bonus eligibility is evaluated, applies for the period you qualify, and adjusts prospectively if eligibility changes; a $10.00 monthly maintenance fee may still apply if you miss the minimum balance requirement.
